label: Gonad and germ cell development, gonadotropin response
reason: Oocyte maturation, follicle growth, Sertoli/Leydig development, FSH/LH response and germ cell biology all form one reproductive development theme.

label: MHC antigen processing and presentation
reason: MHC I/II loading, proteasome, cross-presentation, Nef downregulation of MHC/CD4 and APC surface signatures form one antigen presentation theme; a few T/B/plasma signatures, basigin and exosome terms are a small minority.

label: Inner ear development and vestibular function
reason: Otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canal, otolith, hair cell fate and vestibular reflex/gravity sensing are all inner ear biology.

label: rRNA transcription by RNA polymerase I/III
reason: Pol I initiation, escape and termination, rDNA chromatin regulators (NoRC, SIRT1, B-WICH, CSB) and 5S Pol III transcription all serve ribosomal RNA synthesis.

label: Viral RNA replication and host translation hijacking
reason: Coronavirus genome replication, replicase maturation, frameshifting, capping, PKR/IFIT evasion and host translation modulation form one viral replication theme.

label: Presynaptic neurotransmitter release
reason: Vesicle docking/priming/fusion, SNARE assembly, presynaptic calcium and the transmitter release cycles all describe synaptic vesicle exocytosis.

label: Extracellular matrix proteolysis and degradation
reason: MMP activation, collagen/elastin/hyaluronan catabolism, endopeptidase regulation and ectodomain shedding share extracellular proteolytic remodelling; synoviocyte proliferation is a minor outlier.

label: Glycan biosynthesis and congenital glycosylation disorders
reason: N/O-glycan processing, nucleotide sugar synthesis and transport, sialic acid/fucose metabolism, blood group antigens and CDG defects form one glycosylation theme; leukocyte tethering and sulfation relate via selectin ligands.

label: LDL receptor endocytosis and cholesterol uptake
reason: LDLR/VLDLR internalisation, clathrin cargo recognition, LDL clearance and LXR limitation of cholesterol uptake share receptor-mediated lipoprotein uptake.

label: Phosphate, vitamin D/K and biomineralization
reason: Phosphate transport/FGF23-Klotho, vitamin D activation, vitamin K Gla-protein carboxylation and bone/tooth mineralization are linked as regulators of calcium-phosphate mineralization.

label: SLC transport of organic anions and monocarboxylates
reason: Carboxylate, lactate/pyruvate (MCT with basigin), carnitine, TCA intermediate and organic ion transporters and their SLC disease defects form one membrane metabolite transport theme.

label: Oncogenic FLT3/PDGFR RTK signaling via STAT5
reason: FLT3 ITD/fusion, PDGFRA/B and FGFR1 fusion mutant signaling, CBL regulation, TPO and STAT5 activation share class III RTK signaling in haematopoietic neoplasia.

label: CYP-mediated steroid, vitamin D, retinoid metabolism
reason: Steroidogenesis, vitamin D activation/catabolism and retinoic acid synthesis/degradation are linked by shared cytochrome P450 enzymes producing nuclear-receptor ligand hormones.

label: Rho GTPase control of actin cytoskeleton
reason: Rho family GTPase cycles, WASP/WAVE/formin activation, Arp2/3 nucleation, lamellipodia, ruffles and macropinocytosis are one actin-remodelling theme.

label: mTORC1 nutrient and energy sensing
reason: Amino acid and glucose starvation responses, LKB1-AMPK, TSC/AKT, rapamycin and translation initiation all describe mTORC1 regulation.

label: Cilium assembly and ciliary protein trafficking
reason: IFT, basal body anchoring, transition zone, BBSome and ciliary cargo targeting with centriole biology are one ciliogenesis theme; embryonic brain development is a lone outlier.

label: Skeletal and cardiac myogenesis and regeneration
reason: Myoblast proliferation, fusion and differentiation, satellite cell regeneration and cardiomyocyte proliferation/differentiation are all muscle development.

label: Protein targeting and insertion into ER
reason: SRP-dependent cotranslational targeting, tail-anchored insertion, stop-transfer insertion and ER retention form one ER protein targeting theme; Golgi fusion and folding are minor.

label: Bone remodeling: osteoblast and osteoclast regulation
reason: Osteoblast and osteoclast differentiation, mineralization, RUNX2, BMP/Wnt/TGF-beta stromal programmes and MSC differentiation all concern bone formation and resorption.

label: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone and renal sodium balance
reason: Angiotensin generation and signaling, aldosterone synthesis/secretion, renal sodium excretion and blood volume/pressure regulation form the RAAS axis.

label: Zinc, copper and manganese ion transport
reason: SLC39/SLC30 zinc transport, copper import and detoxification, manganese transport and related diseases share transition metal homeostasis.

label: NF-kappaB activation by TLR/TNFR/IKK signaling
reason: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kB, IKK recruitment, TAK1/TRAF6, TRIF and TNFR1 signaling and IKK deficiencies all describe NF-kB pathway control.

label: Eye development and photoreceptor maintenance
reason: Retina, lens, cornea, iris and eyelid morphogenesis with photoreceptor differentiation and outer segment organization are one eye development theme.

label: TCR signaling and T cell costimulation
reason: CD3/zeta phosphorylation, ZAP-70, CD28/CTLA4/BTLA costimulation, second messengers and T cell activation modules share T cell receptor signaling.

label: Mesenchymal adhesion, migration and ECM
reason: Fibronectin matrix, integrin/syndecan interactions, focal adhesion, stress fibres, fibroblast migration and EMT form one mesenchymal adhesion-migration theme.

label: Iron, heme and copper transport homeostasis
reason: Transferrin cycling, heme scavenging/transport, ferroportin and DMT1 defects, ceruloplasmin and copper/manganese/cobalt transport share transition metal homeostasis.

label: Dopamine receptor signaling and reward behavior
reason: D1/D2 receptor signaling via adenylate cyclase, PLC and arrestin, DARPP-32, amphetamine/nicotine responses and conditioning are dopaminergic neurotransmission.

label: Lipoprotein remodeling and receptor-mediated clearance
reason: Chylomicron/VLDL remodeling, LPL/LIPC lipase activity, VLDL/LDL clearance and LDLR-family endocytosis all describe plasma lipoprotein metabolism.

label: PTEN/PI3K-AKT and inositol phosphate signaling
reason: PTEN regulation and loss, AKT targets, TSC inhibition, nuclear PIP/IP synthesis and inositol pyrophosphates share phosphoinositide-AKT signaling; PAK-2p34 apoptosis terms are a small minority.

label: Blood coagulation, fibrinolysis and VWF
reason: Coagulation cascade, fibrin formation and dissolution, plasminogen regulation, VWF/GPIb variants and platelet degranulation form one haemostasis theme.

label: Systemic blood pressure and blood volume regulation
reason: Renin-angiotensin, bradykinin/neuropeptide catabolism, natriuretic cGMP signaling, vasopressin and renal sodium/urine control all regulate blood pressure.

label: Fatty acid and eicosanoid metabolism, CYP disorders
reason: Lipoxygenase/hepoxilin and 12-HETE synthesis, CYP fatty acid oxidation and its disease defects, and fatty acid transport share fatty acid oxygenation; ABCB6 and SLC33A1 are odd.

label: Platelet GPCR signaling via G12/13 and Rho
reason: Thrombin PAR, ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling with G12/13-Rho activation describe platelet activation signaling.

label: Mitotic chromosome segregation and spindle
reason: Sister chromatid cohesion and separation, condensation, CENP-A deposition, PLK1/AURKA, spindle assembly and checkpoint all describe mitosis.

label: B-vitamin transport and metabolism disorders
reason: Cobalamin uptake, transport and processing defects, propionyl-CoA catabolism and thiamine, riboflavin and biotin metabolism form one B-vitamin theme.

label: MHC class II antigen processing and presentation
reason: MHC II peptide loading, exogenous antigen presentation, CD1 lipid presentation and antigen presentation modules are one antigen presentation theme.

label: Ciliary protein trafficking and ciliogenesis
reason: BBSome, ARL13B, myristoylated and VxPx cargo targeting, transition zone and basal body anchoring all concern cilium assembly and trafficking.

label: Germinal center, Tfh and memory B cells
reason: Tfh differentiation, ICOS and CD27 costimulation, germinal center formation, memory B cell signatures and humoral memory form one theme.

label: Epidermis, keratinization and ectodermal appendage development
reason: Keratinocyte differentiation/cornification and hair, tooth, gland and nail development are linked as ectodermal derivatives sharing EDA/NF-kB signaling; a few junction, ear and ganglion terms are odd.

label: FOXO, NRF2, p53 stress-metabolic transcription
reason: FOXO, NFE2L2 and p53 transcriptional programmes are linked through oxidative stress/redox metabolism (PPP, NADP+) and AKT/GSK3 control; CDK5 neurodegeneration and muscle inactivity terms are minor outliers.
